As of the close of business on February 14, 2013, there were 341 shareholders of record. 
 
 
We have never paid a cash dividend on our shares of common stock and have no current intention to do 
so in the future.   
 
 
We had two repurchase authorizations outstanding during the quarter ended December 31, 2012.  On 
December 14, 2011 (“2011 Authorization”) and December 18, 2012 (“2012 Authorization”), we publicly 
announced the Board of Directors’ approval for us to repurchase up to an aggregate of $300 million per 
authorization, of our common stock in one or more open market and/or privately negotiated transactions.  The 
repurchase authorizations do not have expiration dates.  The following table provides information regarding 
common stock repurchases for the quarter ended December 31, 2012:
